text: 美股三大指数涨跌不一，标普500指数跌0.09%，道指跌0.77%，纳指涨0.09%。大型科技股方面，超威半导体涨2.60%，英伟达涨1.02%，微软跌1.30%。中概股方面，哔哩哔哩涨4.27%，理想汽车涨2.43%，拼多多跌1.50%，京东跌1.66%，蔚来跌1.84%。
text_en: U.S. stocks were mixed across the three major indexes: the S&P 500 fell 0.09%, the Dow fell 0.77%, and the Nasdaq rose 0.09%. Among major tech stocks, AMD rose 2.60%, NVIDIA rose 1.02%, and Microsoft fell 1.30%. Among Chinese ADRs, Bilibili rose 4.27%, Li Auto rose 2.43%, Pinduoduo fell 1.50%, JD.com fell 1.66%, and NIO fell 1.84%.
